oneLiner: A supply-capped supercycle under new CEO John Ternus: the $1,999 iPhone Duo foldable and Gemini-backed Siri AI have launched, but record margins still collide with advanced-node scarcity - at ~37x trailing earnings near a 52-week high.
thesis: The iPhone cycle is real and demand-led. FQ3 iPhone revenue hit a June-quarter record $54.3B, up 22% YoY; the Sept 9, 2026 event added the iPhone 18 Pro ($1,199) and Pro Max ($1,299) plus Apple's first foldable, the iPhone Duo ($1,999), which ships Oct 23.

The Siri overhaul is now in users' hands. iOS 27 began rolling out Sept 14, 2026 with Siri AI (Gemini-assisted) on iPhone 15 Pro and newer, in English beta first, with more languages due in October - the first real test of an AI-driven upgrade cycle.

The tariff overhang reversed into a tailwind. The Supreme Court's Feb 20, 2026 ruling struck down the IEEPA reciprocal tariffs; refunds added roughly 2 points to FQ3 gross margin and $0.11 to EPS, and the India production shift cuts structural exposure.
Record profitability with a fatter mix. FQ3 gross margin of 50.1% and Services at ~28% of revenue underpin 29% EPS growth on 16% revenue growth.
Capital returns remain unmatched: a $100B buyback authorized April 30, 2026 and a $0.27 quarterly dividend - while megacap peers divert cash to AI capex.

latestQuarter.label: Q3 FY2026 (reported July 30, 2026)
points: Revenue $109.4B, +16% YoY, an all-time June-quarter record; GAAP EPS $2.02, +29% (includes $0.11 favorable tariff-refund impact)
Gross margin 50.1%, including ~2pp benefit from tariff refunds
Greater China $18.8B vs ~$19.6B consensus - a miss despite YoY growth
Installed base topped 2.5B active devices; shares fell ~6% after hours on guidance

latestProse: Apple's June quarter (FQ3 FY26, ended June 27) delivered $109.4B in revenue, +16.4% YoY, with GAAP EPS of $2.02 (+29%) and net income of $29.8B. iPhone led at $54.3B (+22%, June-quarter records in every geography), Mac grew 28.7% to $10.4B, while iPad fell 5.9%. Services grew 12.1% to a record $30.7B but missed consensus, and Greater China's $18.8B came in below the ~$19.6B expected. Gross margin reached 50.1%. The disclosure that matters most: roughly 2 points of that margin and $0.11 of EPS came from one-time IEEPA tariff refunds after the Supreme Court struck the tariffs down in February 2026 - flattering optics that won't repeat.
guidanceProse: Apple guided September-quarter revenue growth of 9-11% YoY, below the ~12% LSEG consensus, citing FX and a sharp sequential increase in advanced-node supply constraints; no revision since. Early iPhone 18 Pro reads are mixed: GF Securities' Jeff Pu called pre-order lead times 'lukewarm' and cut Duo builds to 6M from 7M, while Gene Munster saw Pro lead times ~15% longer than last year's launch day.

guide.label: FQ4 revenue growth guide
guide.sub: Below ~12% consensus; supply-constrained (advanced nodes), not demand-constrained

segments: iPhone ~50% of FQ3 revenue ($54.3B of $109.4B), the cycle engine
Services ~28% ($30.7B), the margin engine, now growing ~12%
competitive: Google: simultaneously AI supplier (Gemini underpins Siri AI) and rival (Pixel/Android, Pixel Fold) - an unprecedented coopetition
Samsung: Galaxy Z Fold incumbent now faces the $1,999 iPhone Duo; Apple retains pricing power at the high end
Huawei: pressures China share, where Apple's $18.8B missed consensus; China demand for the Duo is a key swing factor
TSMC allocation vs Nvidia-led AI demand is now a de facto competitive front for 2nm capacity
moat: An installed base above 2.5 billion active devices with deep ecosystem lock-in (App Store, iCloud, iMessage, silicon-software integration) drives industry-best hardware margins and a $120B+ annualized Services attach. Custom silicon and first-claim (though now contested) access to TSMC's leading nodes sustain a multi-year performance lead.
risks: Supply constraints cap the supercycle. The below-consensus FQ4 guide, advanced-node scarcity and reported Duo hinge issues mean record demand may not convert to revenue for several quarters.
Apple rents its AI brain from a rival. Siri AI's reliance on Google Gemini concedes the frontier-model layer and invites antitrust scrutiny of yet another Apple-Google arrangement.

Legal overhangs. A Sept 25, 2026 jury found Apple owes over $5.7B to Taction over Taptic Engine patents (Apple will appeal); DOJ is asking the D.C. Circuit to ban Google's default-search payments to Apple.
China remains fragile. Greater China missed consensus at $18.8B amid Huawei's resurgence.
Margin quality: the tariff refund is one-time. Strip ~2pp of gross margin and $0.11 of EPS and the beat narrows; chip-driven price hikes may test elasticity.
Valuation and execution. At ~$334 and ~37x trailing EPS, a muted iPhone 18 Pro cycle, Duo slip, or stumble in the CEO transition triggers de-rating.
catalysts: Oct 13, 2026 (reported, unconfirmed): Siri AI smart-home hub (~$350 reported), new HomePod and Apple TV
Oct 16 / Oct 23, 2026: iPhone Duo pre-orders / availability
~Oct 29, 2026 (expected, date not yet confirmed by Apple): FQ4 FY26 earnings - first read on iPhone 18 Pro demand, Ternus' first call, holiday guide
Pending: D.C. Circuit appeal on Google search-default payments; Apple appeal of the $5.7B Taction verdict
Dec 2026 quarter: holiday quarter tests whether constrained supply defers or destroys demand
pricedIn: At $333.69 (Oct 2, 2026 close), AAPL sits ~3% below its ~$345 52-week high at ~37x trailing EPS (forward multiple unverified), versus a mid-20s norm; the average analyst target is ~$337 (range $245-$400). The price embeds an iPhone 18/Duo supercycle and Siri AI success. The debate: genuinely supply-capped (demand deferred into FY27) or a weaker run-rate masked by the one-time tariff-refund margin and mixed pre-order reads.

scenarios.bear: Supply limits and Duo hinge yields persist into FY27, capping growth mid-single digits; Siri AI underwhelms; China erodes; the D.C. Circuit bans Google default payments. Ex-refund margins compress and the multiple de-rates toward the mid-20s.
scenarios.base: iPhone 18 Pro and Duo land well; constrained FQ4 demand largely defers into the December and March quarters; Services grows low-double-digits; gross margin holds near 47-48% ex-refunds; the Ternus transition is uneventful; buybacks compound EPS. Stock grinds higher with earnings at ~30x.
scenarios.bull: Siri AI drives the first true AI upgrade cycle across a 2.5B-device base while the Duo opens a new premium tier and supply catches up in FY27; Services reaccelerates. Multiple holds 32x+ on higher FY27 estimates.

valPresets.note: Apple still converts earnings to cash (no capex distortion), so FCF is the honest basis. At ~37x trailing near a 52-week high, even the base preset implies limited upside - which is the point of owning the reverse DCF.
